title: Overview
description: What we know about tabs so far.

add.text:
- **LivePage tabs:** opt-in. `page.tab({name, tab:true})`, and `tab:false` removes one.
- **Each tab is a sub-page:** it has its own folder and URL.
- **Top tabs:** the framework/ai page draws them inline with the title. Compact, and Michael likes them.
- **Transparent tabs:** a second style that leaves the background unchanged.
- **Other suspects:** ui tabs, Page tabs, ext/doc (does Doc extend Page?).
- **Survey:** a minion is queued to map every one of these.
add.title: Known so far
